summary_1line: Aurva defends his vow of vengeance for the Bhrigu massacre, but the Pitris persuade him to cast his world‑destroying wrath into the ocean.

image_candidates.scene_text: Aurva releases the blazing fire of his wrath into the ocean, where it becomes a gigantic horse‑headed flame rising from the waters.
The unborn Aurva listens from his mother’s thigh as terrified Bhrigu women cry out while Kshatriyas slaughter their kin.
